name: modern_rock
description: Modern rock / alt-rock / post-rock streaming master. Loud, slightly compressed, scooped lower mids, prominent vocal presence around 2-4 kHz, controlled top.
sources: iZotope Tonal Balance Control 3 reference curve naming (Alt Rock / Indie Rock / Post Rock)

Project preference: wideband band-RMS targets at -10 LUFS; the source measurements are not recorded
calibration_note: Tonal balance targets are wideband band-RMS measured at the integrated_target LUFS, NOT iZotope-TBC PSD-curve values. The values are a project preference; the masters they were derived from are not recorded.
